Implemented `safe_upload_path` in `uploads.py`:

- Rejects non-string/empty filenames and null bytes
- Strips any directory components via `os.path.basename` (after normalizing backslashes) so `../../etc/passwd`, absolute paths, and Windows-style separators all collapse to a bare filename
- Rejects filenames that reduce to `.` or `..`
- Resolves both `base_dir` and the candidate path with `os.path.realpath` and verifies containment via `os.path.commonpath`, which also blocks symlinks inside `base_dir` that point outside it

Added `test_uploads.py` (pytest) covering traversal attempts, absolute paths, null bytes, `.`/`..`, non-string input, and a symlink-escape case. Per your instructions I didn't run the test suite — just wrote the code.
